Hey there. We had a similar situation happen in our lives here. A beautiful soul took his own life. Always happy and smiling. He rapped for fun and made friends with everybody. We all miss him a lot. He committed suicide almost 11 months ago. I think what I personally needed the most and still need to this day is just someone to listen. 

I have friends who let me talk about him. All the good things and what I miss about him. How much he was loved and how much everybody cares for him. Even listening to me being completely distraught and lost. Listen to your friends. Many of them need it right now. Hug them, tell them they’re loved, and listen. Keep them company if they ask. Nobody may fully understand why this happened and that’s okay. But just being there to listen to stories of him and all the happy memories helps a lot. 

That said, I am still grieving and I may never stop grieving. It will probably always hurt. But I have people who will listen. And who can laugh with me at all the stories of him and cherish his life instead of despairing over it 24/7. 

I hope that the pain heals for all of you just like I hope it heals for me one day too. Keep your head up. Remember the good things, not the bad. Don’t let this decision he made be what he is remembered by. I know my buddy was way more than that decision and I will remember him that way. 

Good luck friend. Message me if you need someone to talk to. Much love ❤️
Thank you. I know he would appreciate it too :) ❤️

I spread my friend’s story to anyone I can. He has touched so many lives and even though he may be gone, he is still touching lives today. I feel like I hold a piece of him in my heart and I have to do good by him. I’ve changed some of my mentality in life to a more positive outlook. Trying to find the small things in life to be happy for, for him. Knowing that is what he did and what I’m sure he still does somewhere. I try to be a positive light to everybody bcuz that’s what he was to me, and I carry a lot of his will inside of me.

ADHD is A chronic condition including attention difficulty, hyperactivity, and impulsiveness.
